_meta.description: Compare each row with one stored record on experiment.pulse. gap_to_unit_1 is ATTR_VEC_DISTANCE (euclidean) from each unit's (revenue_before, revenue) to experiment unit id 1's — reference {record: {keys: [{field: id, value: "1"}]}}, looked up once before the run through the cohort's sidecar index on id (build it first: pulse index build experiment.pulse --key id), the request's own cohort because cohort is omitted (name {filename, data_dir} to read a record of another cohort). The record is read by member column name; a null member is a missing element. No index, a stale one, no match, more than one match or a shard archive refuses the run with its PULSE_INDEX_* / PULSE_LOOKUP_* code, never a fallback; predict checks only the shape.
_meta.name: attr_record_reference
